slides.title: this is your sign to check when your salon license expires.
slides.body: salon owners, before the holiday booking rush. yes, you.

slides.label: step 1
slides.title: not after the december rush. right now.

slides.label: step 2
slides.title: find the license on the wall. read the date, not just the frame.
slides.body: then the stylists' licenses too. every chair.

slides.label: step 3
slides.title: booth renters? ask for their current license and insurance. in writing.
slides.body: "pretty sure it's fine" is not a date.

slides.label: step 4
slides.title: anything expiring before spring gets a reminder 60 days ahead.
slides.body: then go back to your color processing.

slides.title: or let CertTrack track every expiration date for you.
slides.body: licenses, permits and insurance, with alerts before anything expires.

slides.label: p.s.
slides.title: send this to whoever has the license in a drawer.
